decision_rule: parent Jev job order; first eligible committed real choice and eligible ordinal floor(n/2), distinct; no outcome sampling

label_rule.classification: lexicographic primary; an opposing lower-priority primary or secondary makes trade_off; equal primary uses secondary Pareto; no opposing change => improved/degraded; all equal => neutral
label_rule.experience_gate: at least one valid improved pair; trade_off alone requires further research judgment, not automatic positive material
label_rule.missing_secondary: NA ignored with explicit evidence; never interpreted as zero
label_rule.scope: registered intervention with fixed local continuation only; no global optimum or memory effectiveness claim
